baseline.reproduction: This is the source version present before synchronization, frozen for this run. After the source changes, restore the baseline ZIP separately and pass its frontend directory with --baseline-root.

methodology.database: One shared temporary SQLite fixture, migrated/seeded; connect measured before browsing
methodology.origins: two loopback listeners on ephemeral ports; API CORS allows exactly both
methodology.browserProxy: --no-proxy-server only for this temporary Chrome and loopback harness; system settings unchanged
methodology.constrainedProfile: 10Mbps down,5Mbps up,40ms latency; no CPU throttle
methodology.cold: gateway withholds all coupled requests or only separated API for30s; process/SQLite stay alive
methodology.offline: gateway accepts HTTP requests without responding; it does not abort them
methodology.lcp: last observed candidate, not final LCP; cold/offline windows35s/25s with no click/focus/input
methodology.menuReady: MutationObserver sees data-session-role written by layout; functional clicks tested separately
methodology.bytes: sum of CDP Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength for allowed origins, including document; pending/failed responses are incomplete, not total traffic
methodology.requestCount: allowed-origin CDP requests, including document; external blocked requests counted separately
methodology.scope: Local static-host model, not Cloudflare CDN/TLS/cache performance or measured Render cold start

provenance.baselineExtraction: git archive HEAD -- frontend; new TEMP directory; validated entry paths and no symlinks/uploads/node_modules/.env
provenance.baselineExcluded: three mascot art brief TXT files; all public JavaScript and both MJS modules retained
provenance.candidate: Integration working tree based on 1e5580596e89d0bac591a773210e99b220fd0dd0; candidate not yet committed when measured
provenance.order: three sequential coupled/Pages pairs; no concurrent suites; no trace; no public traffic
provenance.sanitization: Complete measurement samples retained; absolute user baseline directory replaced with TEMP token; URL data already reduced to origin labels and pathnames; no headers, bodies, query values, tokens or private hosts recorded

interpretation.baselineSeparation: New comparison against remote frontend 1e55805 with contextual mascot and admin modules. It must not be combined with the older ZIP baseline or the historical 4948/5816ms comparison.
interpretation.observedChanges: LCP remains the facade image at 225120 visible pixels; baseline uses PNG and candidate WebP. The integrated initial route no longer preloads inactive Farmi/Boti atlases. These combined frontend changes reduce observed traffic; this run does not isolate their individual effects or attribute the whole LCP difference to hosting separation.
interpretation.limits: Three local warm pairs, fresh browser contexts and disabled cache. Same temporary SQLite/API. No CDN, TLS, real Render/Cloudflare deployment, user traffic, CPU throttle, cold or offline run. Last observed LCP candidate, not a field percentile.
